sources.description: The aircraft owner's statement of the hardware in ArduPilot forum topic 144558 (posts 4 and 12), recorded in data/flight-logs/inventory.json; not a datasheet.

The aircraft's own battery voltage thresholds in its log topic-144558-00000205.BIN (data/flight-logs/inventory.json): MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX 24.6 V and MOT_BAT_VOLT_MIN 16.8 V over six cells; the owner's settings, not a cell datasheet.

applicability: Two 6S 21 Ah packs in parallel (the log's MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX is 24.6 V); maker not stated.
